currentParagraphText: “Hey, I can’t look like a cheapskate,” Villy shrugged. “This will be your first time officially visiting another major faction as my Chosen. It’s a pretty big deal in the grand scheme of things, and it’s only expected that some proper gifts are brought. Plus, the more I give them, the more Nature’s Attendant and Yggdrasil are able to give you in return without it seeming improper.”
